The complete 13-component state contains six total strains, six viscoplastic strains and accumulated equivalent viscoplastic strain; results include all six dry total Cauchy stresses. Approval covers the bounded source-derived numerical study. Presets are illustrative; custom coefficients, starting states and loading times need their own accuracy checks.
